commits.subject: Patch targetSdk 35 and enable R8 via workflow sed after cap sync
commits.stat:
f56c97e Patch targetSdk 35 and enable R8 via workflow sed after cap sync
 .github/workflows/android-aab.yml | 10 ++++++++--
 1 file changed, 8 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
commits.diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/android-aab.yml b/.github/workflows/android-aab.yml
index aa4cec7..9abe591 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/android-aab.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/android-aab.yml
@@ -43,8 +43,8 @@ jobs:
       - name: Setup Android SDK
         uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
 
-      - name: Install Android 34 SDK packages
-        run: sdkmanager "platform-tools" "platforms;android-34" "build-tools;34.0.0"
+      - name: Install Android 35 SDK packages
+        run: sdkmanager "platform-tools" "platforms;android-35" "build-tools;35.0.0"
 
       - name: Accept Android SDK licenses
         run: yes | sdkmanager --licenses
@@ -64,6 +64,12 @@ jobs:
         run: npx cap sync android
         working-directory: web
 
+      - name: Patch Android SDK version and enable R8
+        run: |
+          sed -i 's/compileSdkVersion = .*/compileSdkVersion = 35/' web/android/variables.gradle
+          sed -i 's/targetSdkVersion = .*/targetSdkVersion = 35/' web/android/variables.gradle
+          sed -i 's/minifyEnabled false/minifyEnabled true/' web/android/app/build.gradle
+
       - name: Read app version
         id: version
         run: |
